This is just coordinated agitation by progressive activists attempting to undermine lawful authority, traditional leadership, and the stability of our great nation. Instead of respecting the constitutional order and personal responsibility, these groups are out in the streets pushing division. We refuse to let radical organisers rewrite the facts or bully the American people with their inflated crowd counts.

This is just coordinated agitation by progressive activists attempting to undermine lawful authority, traditional leadership, and the stability of our great nation. Instead of respecting the constitutional order and personal responsibility, these groups are out in the streets pushing division. We refuse to let radical organisers rewrite the facts or bully the American people with their inflated crowd counts.
